aboutGame.title: What is Steal A Verity?
paragraphs: Steal A Verity is a free-to-play Roblox steal-and-grow tycoon where up to seven players share a server and race to build the richest base. You claim a plot, raid crates guarded by Monster Verity or swipe boxes from rival players, then carry the loot home before someone intercepts you.

Back at your base, boxes are dropped onto a hatch pad to reveal Verity Pets that generate passive income. That cash funds treadmill training for permanent Speed, which in turn unlocks heavier crates, rarer pet variants and safer escapes. Master the loop of steal, hatch, earn and upgrade, and you climb from easy target to server tycoon.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Steal A Verity.

items.question: What is Steal A Verity?
items.answer: Steal A Verity is a free-to-play Roblox steal-and-grow tycoon. You claim a base plot, raid crates guarded by Monster Verity or steal boxes from rival players, hatch Verity Pets for passive income, and train Speed on your treadmill until no one on the server can catch you.

items.question: Are there any Steal A Verity codes?
items.answer: No. There are currently no active developer-issued Steal A Verity codes. Avoid third-party code generators, which compromise your account security without granting any real reward. Progress comes from box runs, pet income and treadmill training.

items.question: What is the most important stat in Steal A Verity?
items.answer: Movement Speed. It decides whether a haul survives the trip home, so reinvest pet income into treadmill upgrades before buying cosmetic items. Most players target 10k Speed for comfortable Monster Verity routes and 50k before hunting Legendary crates.

items.question: How do I stop players from stealing my pets in Steal A Verity?
items.answer: Move your highest earners to the back of the plot, block sightlines from the entrance, and upgrade gates and vault enclosures early. Keep treadmill sessions short or check your entry lanes regularly, since raiders target players who are locked into AFK training.

items.question: How do I hatch Verity Pets in Steal A Verity?
items.answer: Steal a box from Monster Verity or another player, carry it back to your base, and drop it on the hatch pad to reveal a pet. Rarer boxes roll from stronger rarity pools, and every new pet you discover is logged in your Index.
